Start at https://www.drugs.com/ and complete the following task by navigating within that website.

Identify a pill with a pink color and oval shape with 894 5 number on it.

Rules:
- Work entirely in this one browser tab. Do NOT open new tabs.
- Do NOT use a search engine (Google, Bing, etc.) or cached/archived copies (e.g. web.archive.org). Navigate the site itself, starting from https://www.drugs.com/.
- When the task is complete, give your final answer as plain text in your last message.
